rationale: The plan matches the reference on every axis: raw STAR/featureCounts counts go directly into DESeq2 Wald (with an edgeR QL cross-check), no tximport, no length offset, and an explicit statement that TPM/FPKM do not apply to a 3' tag library. Normalization is median-of-ratios/TMM inside the model, the design ~condition has an explicit control reference and a (condition, treated, control) contrast, BH at 0.05 with independent filtering and apeglm shrinkage, and any fold-change threshold is correctly deferred to lfcThreshold. QC (blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, library sizes, explicit no-drop policy) precedes the model, the filter uses the lower 5-in-3 floor with the retained gene count reported, enrichment is correctly omitted, and the report specifies method, versions, design, thresholds, n tested/n DE, power caveat, and reproducibility record. The only slip is the filter justification's claim that long genes collect fewer reads in a 3' library, which is imprecise (all genes get one read per molecule), though the chosen floor itself is correct.
